messages:
maria: quick sync — opened a PR to consolidate the timeout/429/context-limit snippets across python/js/cli. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 

olivia: thanks! skimmed — looks good overall. two things: the python retry example still uses an old backoff helper we removed last quarter. we should standardize on the new RetryPolicy.

sanjay: can you paste the old vs new snippet? i can help update the python one.

maria: old snippet: ```py
from redwood.utils import backoff_retry
result = backoff_retry(client.generate, retries=3)
```
new snippet (recommended): ```py
from redwood.sdk.retry import RetryPolicy
policy = RetryPolicy(max_retries=3, jitter=True)
result = client.generate(prompt, retry_policy=policy)
```

olivia: also noticed the 429 guidance page references a deprecated query param `fast=true` in the JS example. needs link fix + short note about prefer fallbacks over aggressive retries.

maria: agreed — plan: (1) update python snippet to RetryPolicy, (2) update JS snippet to remove fast=true and add fallback example, (3) add a short note in the context-limits doc about trimming KV cache before shortening total tokens.

dennis: for the JS fallback example, propose this minimal pattern: ```js
try {
  const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-lite', prompt })
  return resp
} catch (err) {
  if (err.code === 429) {
    // fallback to smaller model variant
    return client.generate({ model: 'gpt-mini', prompt })
  }
  throw err
}
```

maria: that looks good. can we add a note about exponential backoff + `Retry-After` header handling? tiny code comment should suffice.

olivia: also pinging @docs-bot to run the snippet linter and check for duplicate anchors across pages.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: running for PR #4823... found 3 duplicate anchors: `/docs/errors#timeouts`, `/docs/errors#timeouts` (duplicate), `/docs/limits#context-window`. Suggested action: de-duplicate anchors and convert one to an internal reference.

ci-bot: PR #4823 check: docs build failed — broken link in `errors/429.md` -> `/api/?fast=true` (404). Full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/4823/logs

maria: i'll remove `?fast=true` and replace with the routing policy link. tagging @sanjay for the python snippet update and @dennis for the js fallback note.

sanjay: on it. will push a small commit to the branch tonight (will follow the RetryPolicy import path in new core).

dennis: i'll add the `Retry-After` handling comment and a one-line note about when to prefer model variant fallback vs backoff.

olivia: once patches are in, can someone run the `docs-bot snippet-lint` locally? i don't want another duplicate anchor roll-forward. also please add one integration test that checks the errors doc links (we have a tiny test harness at scripts/docs_link_check.sh).

maria: good call. i'll add the script to the PR and run it in CI. hoping to merge tomorrow after reviews. thanks folks :raised_hands:

olivia: tiny docs nit — change header "Context limits" -> "Context limits & KV cache" to make the caching guidance more discoverable.

maria: done in draft, will push with other commits.

dennis: quick Q — should the examples show `client.generate` streaming vs non-streaming? currently the JS fallback only covers non-streaming.

olivia: prefer keep non-streaming for brevity; add a one-liner note pointing to the streaming fallback appendix.

maria: final checklist before merge: update python snippet, update js snippet, fix link, run snippet-lint, run docs_link_check.sh, add tiny integration test. if anyone sees anything missing, shout now.

sanjay: looks complete from my side.

dennis: same.

ci-bot: PR #4823 check: all checks passed after rerun.

maria: merged — thanks everyone! will follow up if any user feedback comes in.
